3.3.7.1 Derived Parameter Calculation Formula
A derivation of a Conﬁguration Parameter value can be speciﬁed by an informal Calcu-
lation Formula or by a formal language that can be used to specify the computational
rules (see ﬁgure 3.18). The formal language is deﬁned in the Generic Structure Tem-
plate [11]. With this formal language it is possible to express dependencies between
parameters and e.g. to calculate a value of one parameter based on other parameter
values.
